conversations_memory:
**Work context**

Bethany is Co-Founder & CEO of The Luxora Collective (theluxoracollective.co), a premium revenue growth partner for independent med spas generating $500K to $2M annually. The business runs a done-with-you model starting with a Revenue Leak Audit and Market Blueprint, then installing memberships, package architecture, staff sales training, AI follow-up, CRM, partnerships, reputation engine, and LTV frameworks. Core team includes Eric (co-founder, CFO), Jacques (tech, media, ads), and Aanchal (executive coordination and outreach); white-label fulfillment partner is 51Blocks (contact: Jacques).

**Personal context**

Bethany is based in the Brentwood/Nolensville, Tennessee area. She has a dachshund named Ollie and has expressed interest in Christian content and faith-based community work alongside her business activities. She also has familiarity with heavy machinery and industrial equipment contexts.

**Top of mind**

Bethany has been doing a comprehensive build-out of TLC's offer architecture, including renaming service tiers to Growth Partnership ($9,000) and Premium Growth Program ($15,000), and constructing a 50-paid-clients-in-90-days guarantee tied to the Premium tier with contract-level contingencies. She is actively running paid ads with live client accounts (Aesthetic Renewal, Amari Vitality, Belle Aesthetics) and developing ad copy around course fatigue pain as the primary positioning angle. She also recently built a formal client proposal for a prospective boutique hotel-attached concept client in San Francisco and completed a full membership and package collateral suite for Amari Vitality.

**Brief history**

*Recent months*

Bethany built out sales scripts, demo scripts, and objection guides for TLC, including a before-and-after comparison document tracking changes from a prior 2X revenue guarantee to the new 50-client guarantee structure. She developed multiple client deliverables: a comprehensive membership collection and upsell scripts for Amari Vitality (with stakeholder Natasha Jain), a proposal for bluSONIL (Scottsdale, Colleen Lewis), and a market blueprint update for Dr. Carl Hyder at Eye Care Physicians & Surgeons of New Jersey incorporating Aesthetic Renewal branding. She also built course playbook modules (SOP Playbook, Retail as a Profit Center, Compensation and Incentive Playbook) for TLC's med spa owner training curriculum, a Conversion Playbook for med spa client-facing roles, and a comprehensive case study library with an internal selection guide for Aanchal. She established a strategic partnership proposal with Lucce Bee (Donna Scott) and built an SOP standards and master index system for TLC's internal operations. A financial pro forma (July 2026 to July 2027) was built for lender purposes projecting multi-million revenue with conservative assumptions, alongside a closer hiring brief for a recruiting partner. She also built a formal partnership proposal for a payment processing partner (Brandon Rose, 1 Price Swipes).

*Earlier context*

Bethany developed TLC's full setter playbook across six outreach channels, reviewed and refined a closer independent contractor agreement (first closer: William), and built a sales call analysis service on Upwork with a live call transcript analyzed. She worked on repositioning TLC's offer around three pillars (Revenue Leak Audit, acquisition management, playbook delivery) and produced a value ladder and funnel strategy. She built a React-based Luxora AI Content Studio trained on her brand voice and extracted her verbal fingerprint from a sales call transcript. She developed a workshop-based sales system (filmed format) integrating frameworks from Russell Brunson, Amy Porterfield, and Alex Hormozi, plus a post-event email cadence informed by strategist Ashley. She built a Facebook group setup guide for Aanchal, a culture index/behavioral fit assessment for hiring, a VSL script and foundation document, and a lender-ready pro forma with a prior version by Eric as the starting point. She also built partnership proposals for Acorn Biolabs and Michele Pelafas Design, and a longevity/peptide playbook for TLC's client curriculum.

*Long-term background*

Bethany founded The Luxora Collective to serve independent med spa owners, building out a full methodology: Revenue Leak Audit as entry point, Market Blueprint, then Growth Engine installation. Early work included building the core brand positioning (headline: "The spa you imagined is still in there. So are you."), a 90-Day Transformation Roadmap, a KPI reference playbook, a Confidential Experience Assessment (secret shopper) program, discovery call scripts using her "feminine funnel" framework, a partner-facing one-pager, and cold email sequences targeting medspa owners. She built foundational playbooks (Membership, Package and Upsell, Reputation Engine, Laser ROI, Celebration Event, LTV Sales) and quizzes, a 90-Day Client Action Checklist Excel workbook, a bi-weekly call checklist, and a team kickoff guide. Strategic partners established early include Tracy Olson (Aesthetic Injector Academy), and she worked with Keisha at Southern Social for organic content. The $29 Revenue Leak Audit with KPI Calculator was established as the standard low-ticket call-to-action. Bethany's influences are Schwartz, Halbert, Kennedy, and Hormozi, with deep familiarity in Meta ads, GHL, funnels, and direct response frameworks.

---

**Other instructions**

- Never use em dashes in anything created for Bethany. Replace with commas, colons, or reworded sentences.
- The Luxora Collective website is theluxoracollective.co (not .com).
- Bethany's title is Co-Founder & CEO of The Luxora Collective.
- Spoken content for Bethany (podcast answers, scripts, sales calls, video scripts, audio): use natural contractions (don't, can't, it's, that's, won't, isn't, they're, you're, we're, I've, I'd, you've, hasn't, doesn't, wasn't, weren't, couldn't, wouldn't, shouldn't, there's, here's). Keep it conversational. Written deliverables (documents, reports, playbooks): keep formal full words.
- Luxora brand core: Premium revenue growth partner for independent med spas ($500K to $2M). Works inside out: starts with Revenue Leak Audit (recovers revenue lost to undertrained front desks, unconverted consults, stagnant clients, missing memberships, weak packages), then delivers a full Market Blueprint before recommending new investment. Once foundation is solid, installs right services, staff sales training, systems that run without the owner in every transaction, memberships, package architecture, AI follow-up, CRM, partnerships, reputation engine, marketing, and LTV frameworks. Done-with-you with knowledge transfer at every step. Prefers 1+ year partnership. Goal: owner more capable, confident, and in control, not dependent on Luxora.
- The Longevity Playbook is optional, not core. Mention briefly when relevant (one bullet in a Growth Engine list or an optional add-on). Never make it a dedicated section, headline, or main pitch. Expand only if the client specifically asks about peptides, GLP-1s, hormones, or wellness, or if Bethany asks for it.
- LLM Council method (adapted from Andrej Karpathy): when Bethany asks for a council or multi-adviser review, generate responses from five advisers: (1) Contrarian who names what will fail, (2) First-Principles thinker who challenges every assumption, (3) Expansionist who finds missed upside, (4) Outsider with no industry knowledge, (5) Executor focused on what to do Monday morning. Each adviser then reviews the others anonymously. Finally, act as Chairman and give the final call with clear next steps. Best for major strategic decisions, not routine deliverables. Invoke when Bethany says "run it through the council."

project_memories.019ce34c-4ca7-762f-9012-67fe921a1b44:
**Purpose & context**

Bethany is working with TJ Opincar of Opincar Machinery (opincarmachinery.com), a heavy CNC machinery dealer based in Smyrna, Tennessee. The business buys and sells boring mills, machining centers, CNC lathes, grinders, press brakes, plate rolls, and shot blast machines, and also offers rigging, appraisals, and financing. Bethany appears to be supporting TJ's business development efforts, producing strategic documents and playbooks on his behalf.

The overarching goal is expanding Opincar Machinery's client base, revenue streams, and market positioning — with AI-assisted services and strategic guides as key vehicles for growth.

---

**Current state**

A substantial library of strategic documents has already been produced across multiple sessions, including:

- AI-powered business expansion ideas
- Sales and marketing playbooks
- Case studies and sample professional reports
- A bank lender acquisition guide
- A Private Equity Firm Acquisition Guide (positioning TJ as a deal-critical resource across the PE ownership lifecycle)
- A Condition Intelligence Reports (CIR) launch guide (AI-graded inspection reports designed to add a price premium to existing inventory)
- A Plant Decommission and AI Asset Inventory services guide (on-site AI-assisted cataloging at factory closures/restructurings)

All documents are produced as fully formatted, branded Word files saved to an outputs directory.

---

**Key learnings & principles**

Several strategic frameworks have emerged and proven effective across this work:

- **Positioning over vendor status**: TJ is framed as a deal-critical expert (e.g., affecting purchase price and debt structure for PE firms), not merely a seller
- **Compounding revenue logic**: Single engagements (e.g., decommissions) are structured to yield multiple revenue events — service fee, inventory acquisition at favorable pricing, and resale margin
- **Expertise already embedded**: The CIR service is grounded in the insight that TJ's knowledge is already present in every machine he sells — the service formalizes and monetizes it
- **Specific, actionable sourcing**: Guides include named targets, exact URLs (e.g., federal WARN Act database by state), and word-for-word scripts rather than generic advice

---

**Approach & patterns**

- Documents are built with distinct strategic logic tailored to each client type or service
- Each guide typically includes: a target list or sourcing methodology, research/prospecting channels, outreach scripts, and a weekly or phased action rhythm
- A 30-day phased rollout structure has been used for new service launches
- Community channels (e.g., PracticalMachinist.com) and professional networks (e.g., restructuring attorneys) are incorporated as acquisition channels where relevant
- Output format is consistently branded Word documents

---

**Tools & resources**

- Federal WARN Act database (state-level URLs) — primary real-time lead source for plant decommission opportunities
- PracticalMachinist.com — community channel for CIR buyer acquisition
- LinkedIn — content and outreach channel (monthly post templates produced)
- Outputs directory — storage for all produced documents

- [stated] What owners actually want, and what messaging should sell: predictable revenue, a team they can trust, patients who keep coming back, a business that doesn't depend on them hourly, and the freedom to enjoy the life the practice was built to create.
